notes: POWO accepts R. metziae; R. metziae var. marshii is treated as a synonym.

target_zone_range_leads.guardrail: Research-only. Deep Review must verify accepted taxonomy and exact target-zone native counties; no county inference.
leads: POWO lists Texas to northeastern Mexico as native.
Purola Preserve's natural-flora list records R. metziae in north Hays County.
UT Williamson County provides a detailed local treatment; Deep Review should add a third exact target-zone county before PASS.

morphology_candidate.look_here_first: Start with flower color and inflorescence: large white flowers are carried in a terminal panicle of opposite cymes whose axes and calyx are densely stalked-glandular-hairy.
diagnostic_traits: perennial herb under about 40 cm in the Williamson treatment
elliptic to narrowly ovate opposite leaves
dense stalked glandular hairs in upper inflorescence
very large white corolla about 59–65 mm in the Williamson treatment

confusers.separator: R. ciliatiflora has violet/purple flowers; R. metziae has conspicuously large white flowers and strongly glandular upper inflorescence.
